subject: general
question: Who among the following is one of the recipients of the Dadasaheb Phalke Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Kapoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shashi Kapoor**

 
 
• Shashi Kapoor received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award in** 2014**.
 
• He was the **46th** recipient of the award, which is the highest honor in Indian cinema.
 
• The award was presented to him by the then Information and Broadcasting Minister** Arun Jaitley**.
 
• Shashi Kapoor was a versatile actor who starred in over **175 films over a 40-year career**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke Award**

 
 
• The award was instituted in **1969** and is named after Dadasaheb Phalke, who is considered the "**Father of Indian Cinema**" for directing the first Indian feature film, Raja Harishchandra, in **1913**.
 
• The award is presented annually at the **National Film Awards** ceremony and consists of a **Swarna Kamal** (Golden Lotus) medallion, a shawl, and a cash prize of **₹1,000,000**.
 
• As of 2023, there have been** 52 recipients **of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award. Some of the most notable recipients include:
 
 
• Devika Rani (1969)
 
• Satyajit Ray (1976)
 
• Lata Mangeshkar (1989)
 
• Raj Kapoor (1987)
 
• Amitabh Bachchan (2018)
 
• A. R. Rahman (2012)
 
• S. S. Rajamouli (2018)
 
• Rajinikanth (2019)
 
• Asha Parekh (2020)
 
• Rekha (2023)
